graph_subtitle: Find the exact sweet spot for your daily games to maintain a high win rate in your current ELO and check back whenever you rank up
js_default_text: Hover over a rank to see the pacing analysis.

js_texts.mestre: Master+: Absolute High Performance. Micro-mistakes here cost the entire game. Your peak is 2 games max; from the 3rd game onward, decision fatigue completely ruins your LP gains. No room for throwing here.
js_texts.diamante: Diamond: Consistency is King. You can stay sharp for about 3 to 4 games. Forcing long shop sessions triggers 'autopilot'—the ultimate ladder-stuck killer in High ELO.
js_texts.esmeralda: Plat & Emerald: The Toxic Mental Gaps. Your mechanics will hold until game 4, but your patience with trash talk and throws drops fast. Save your ELO: log off if you lose two in a row.
js_texts.ouro: Gold: Mid-Tier Balance. You can grind a decent volume (up to 5-6 games) because throws aren't instantly punished, but your macro focus and map awareness fade hard by the end of the session.
js_texts.prata: Silver: Practice Volume. Fatigue rarely tanks your win rate here since the bracket demands less raw macro focus. Spamming games to fix your core mechanics and master your main champ is the way to go.
js_texts.ferro: Iron/Bronze: Brute Force. Fatigue isn't the bottleneck down here. Grinding out game volume to learn matchups and limit-testing beats mental drain. Just /mute all and carry on with long sessions.
